{{Quote|Here’s what they took, in order of loading. Cold-weather equipment and cold-weather modification kits. Critical replacement parts for a SURO-10 power generator, a KDY DSS-02 shield generator, and some Atgar P-tower laser cannon. They probably also have at least one Golan Arms DF.9 anti-infantry cannon, along with several combat-modified T-47 airspeeders and the equipment to modify more.|Senior Captain Thrawn to Darth Vader|<ref name="COO" />}}
The '''SURO-10 power generator''' was a type of power generator. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> critical replacement parts for a SURO-10 power generator were among the supplies stolen by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor]]. Upon reviewing a list of the stolen equipment, Senior [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] noted that the shipment also included cold-weather gear, replacement parts for a [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|KDY]] [[DSS-02 shield generator|DSS-02 shield generator]], components for [[Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation/Legends|Atgar]] [[1.4 FD P-Tower/Legends|P-tower laser cannons]], and other military hardware. The presence of the parts contributed to Thrawn's assessment that the Rebels were establishing a base on a remote, cold world.<ref name="COO" />
